snp1.1:1.1: A monk who removes anger when it appears,
snp1.1:1.2: as one removes a serpent’s venom using medicines,
snp1.1:1.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:1.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:2.1: A monk who completely cuts off passion,
snp1.1:2.2: like a lotus plant dropping its flowers,
snp1.1:2.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:2.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
snp1.1:3.1: A monk who has completely severed craving,
snp1.1:3.2: who has dried up the swiftly flowing river,
snp1.1:3.3: relinquishes both the here and the beyond
snp1.1:3.4: like a snake shedding its decayed skin.
